blurb: Hélibellule is an FBO located directly on the tarmac of Montréal-Mirabel International Airport (CYMX). They offer a unique, enjoyable, comfortable and safe experience with large, bright public spaces and functional private spaces. Their services include fueling, deicing, parking, cargo handling, and dedicated crew areas.
